answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy makes each identity post a 1000 POA bond locked for 30 days and complete three distinct tasks. Five independent established peers must verify signed logs; fraud, duplicate identities, or replayed proofs burn the bond and trigger a seven-day cooldown. A rotating quorum and two passing rounds make a large fake network expensive to sustain: marble records are sealed in a vault, while inlet checks flag coordinated timing.
